what: https://api.certspotter.com removed from the Content-Security-Policy connect-src: NEXUM no longer asks SSLMate Cert Spotter; Certificate Transparency lookups open crt.sh or Cert Spotter on their own sites (links).
why: SSLMate's API documentation: unauthenticated queries are 'for personal or evaluation purposes'; production use requires an account and a key (legal item L62, NEXUM-OSIRIS audit). A public site may not use it keyless.
